title: Fill-rate census over the 284 x 10 extraction matrix
question: Of the 2,840 cells in the 284-candidate by 10-dimension extraction matrix, how many hold an evidence-anchored value, how many are honest nulls, and how many are silently empty?

control_fixture.note: Planted both-states fixture; not mixed into the 2840 live cells.

tests.name: the three states must never be collapsed into filled-versus-unfilled
the 30-cell re-derivation error rate must be reported and, if it exceeds the stated threshold, the whole dimension is re-run
per-family totals are mandatory: the G-skill family is 96 of 284 and can dominate an aggregate

reviewer.method: 30-cell independent re-derivation plus planted both-states controls
